llm_request:
Please help me write a brief follow-up email to a client. The email should:
- Say it was nice talking with them
- Introduce myself as their account manager/follow-up contact
- Let them know they can contact me if they have any questions

Please keep it professional but warm, and concise.
llm_response:
Here are a couple of options, depending on how formal your relationship with the client is:

**Option 1: Warm and standard (Best for most situations)**

**Subject:** Great speaking with you / Introduction

Hi [Client Name],

It was so nice speaking with you earlier today. 

As we discussed, I will be your dedicated account manager moving forward. My main goal is to ensure you have everything you need and are getting the absolute most out of our services. 

If any questions come up as you get started, please don't hesitate to reach out to me directly. I'm always happy to help!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title/Account Manager]
[Your Contact Information]

***

**Option 2: Slightly more conversational and brief**

**Subject:** Following up - Great connecting with you!

Hi [Client Name],

It was great connecting with you today! 

Just a quick note to officially introduce myself as your new account manager and main point of contact. I’m very much looking forward to working with you. 

If you have any questions at all, please feel free to reach out to me anytime via email or phone. 

Warmly,

[Your Name]
[Your Title/Account Manager]
[Your Contact Information]
